verdict.rationale: EFTPS publishes its operating window up front: payments can be made 24/7, must be scheduled by 8 p.m. ET the day before the due date to count as timely, and can be scheduled up to 365 days ahead. Nothing in the pack covers per-day payment limits or session timeouts, so only part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: published per-day/transaction limits, published session-timeout duration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
